chapter: Danny's rise through New York bands to Cab Calloway
title: Allsbrook's judo and The Thirteen Families That Run America
summary: Allsbrook tossed Milt against a wall and read about the families that run America.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Adolphus knew about Judo, and we didn't know anything about it. He said, "Come on, I'll show you something." And he threw up against the wall. I thought the building was gonna... VROOM! He would get up...
And he got this book, The Thirteen Families That Run America...
...and he talked about that. Do you remember that?
Yeah, he was annoyed by that shit. The thirteen, fifteen first families of America. The Firestones, the Rockefellers, he knew their names...
He knew some families in Japan. He had it all together.
The people with all the money..
Yeah, the people that run the country. You do what they say.
